title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

title: Working Student Integrations
description:
About Dataleap

Dataleap (YC S24) is building the agentic operating system for the enterprise. Supported by $3M in funding from YC and industry-leading angels (including Aravind from Perplexity and Rahul Vohra from Superhuman), we’re scaling rapidly with thousands of agents deployed, doubling revenue every month, and facing more enterprise demand than we can handle.

About the Role

We're looking for a working student (20h/week, €30/hour) to co-own our integrations—this is real ownership from the start. You’ll work directly with the founders, ship code to production in your first week, and have an immediate impact on our agentic AI platform.

If you’d like to be part of a fast-growing YC startup, develop deep technical expertise, and potentially join full-time after graduation, we want to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own, design, and implement integrations for our agentic systems end to end.

  • Work directly with the founders and be a key contributor from day one.

  • Ship working software to production quickly—no red tape.

  • Build and improve our tooling and workflows (APIs, automation, AI-first processes).

  • Interface with customers and our core team to understand and solve real-world integration challenges.

  • Shape the technical future of our integrations foundation.

You’re a Fit If

  • You have strong technical skills, especially in Python and TypeScript.

title: Internship Teleoperation & Data Labeling
description:
Internship – Teleoperation & Data Labeling (m/f/d)

Who We Are

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview

We are looking for a tech-savvy intern with a passion for robotics, machine learning, or computer vision who wants hands-on experience in teleoperation and operating state-of-the-art robots. This role is perfect for someone eager to learn, contribute, and gain practical exposure to advanced AI-driven robotic systems.

Your Responsibilities

  • Robot Teleoperation: Collect high-quality data by controlling robots through a VR headset.

  • Data Labeling: Label visual data (images, point clouds) with speed and precision.

  • Use terminal basics to run existing tooling (bash + Python scripts) for data collection, uploads, and checks

  • Do simple debugging: reproduce issues, collect logs, and write clear problem reports (steps, expected vs actual, timestamps, logs/screenshots)

  • Collaboration: Work with a fast-paced, innovative tech team.

  • Travel to different sites within the EU may be required
